info.title: Digital Bunkering — IBMS Webhook Event Trigger
info.description:
Endpoint used by IBMS to trigger a webhook event for a bunkering order.

The order identity is supplied in parts (`stemNo` + optional `refItemNo`); the server derives the internal composite order id as `{stemNo}-{refItemNo}` when `refItemNo` is present, or `{stemNo}` when it is empty or null. The event is queued and delivered asynchronously to the caller's registered callback URL — a `200` here means *accepted for delivery*, not *delivered*.

host.description: Replace with the actual environment host (dev / staging / production)

tags.name: External IBMS Webhooks
tags.description: Webhook registration and event triggering for external IBMS integrations

post.summary: Trigger a webhook event for an order
post.description:
Queues a webhook event for the caller's latest active registered webhook.

Processing order:
1. Authenticate the JWT (`token` header or cookie).
2. Resolve the caller's latest **active** webhook registration; `401` if none exists.
3. Validate `event` against the globally allowed event types.
4. Validate `event` is one of the event types that webhook registration subscribed to.
5. Require a non-empty `stemNo`.
6. Derive the order id and push the event onto the delivery queue.

withRefItemNo.summary: Order with a ref item number — resolves to order id "S12345-1"

withoutRefItemNo.summary: Order without a ref item number — resolves to order id "S12345"

loadingOperation.summary: Loading nomination — routes to the loading document builder

200.description: Event accepted and pushed onto the delivery queue.

400.description: Invalid request body — unknown event type, event type not subscribed to by the webhook registration, or missing `stemNo`.

invalidEventType.summary: `event` is not a recognised event type

eventNotAllowed.summary: `event` is valid but not subscribed to by this webhook registration

value.message: Event type 'operation.castoff' is not allowed for this webhook

malformedToken.summary: Token present but could not be decoded

401.description: Authentication failed, or the caller has no active webhook registration.

noActiveWebhook.summary: Caller has not registered an active webhook

value.status: No active webhook found for user

402.description: Returned by the authentication middleware when the token decodes but fails the validity check. Legacy behaviour — treat as an authentication failure.

500.description: Unexpected server error while queueing the event.

TokenHeaderAuth.name: token
TokenHeaderAuth.description: Raw JWT in a `token` header. Note this is **not** an `Authorization: Bearer` header — the value is the bare token.

TokenCookieAuth.name: token
TokenCookieAuth.description: Raw JWT in a `token` cookie. Accepted as an alternative to the `token` header; the header takes precedence when both are present.

event.description: The operation event being reported. Must also be one of the event types the caller's webhook registration subscribed to.

stemNo.description: Stem number of the order. Required and non-empty; whitespace-only values are rejected. Numeric values are coerced to string server-side, but sending a string is recommended.

refItemNo.description: Reference item number of the order line. Optional — may be omitted, `null`, or an empty string. When present and non-empty, the internal order id becomes `{stemNo}-{refItemNo}`; otherwise it is just `{stemNo}`. Whitespace-only values are treated as empty.

isLoading.description: Routing flag. When `true` the event is resolved against loading nominations and the worker builds the loading document; when `false` (default) it follows the delivery order path.

status.description: Authentication failure reason. Note this field is named `status`, not `error`.
